notes: DUPLICATE-CATALOGUE DETERMINATION (per BRIEF flag vs S.N. 28 'HAY US', c28.json): hay.dk is NOT a separate Danish storefront/catalogue -- it 301-redirects into the same global www.hay.com site already captured in c28.json, with identical product counts. Evidence: (1) https://hay.dk/ 301s to https://www.hay.com/ (verified via curl -I -L); (2) deep category paths also redirect through, e.g. https://hay.dk/products/lighting/ceiling -> Location: https://www.hay.com/products/lighting/ceiling; (3) www.hay.com's own footer 'Select Country' page (/country-selector) lists Denmark at /country-selector/danmark, which 302-redirects back to https://www.hay.com/ and only sets a cookie Hay.countrySelected=Denmark -- no separate domain or subpath, same architecture c28 documented for the USA selection; (4) /da and /dk path variants on www.hay.com both 404; (5) empirical tile-count cross-check: re-fetched all 6 PLP categories used in c28 with Cookie 'Hay.countrySelected=Denmark' and got byte-identical <div class="hayproduct"> tile counts to both the USA-cookie and no-cookie fetches and to c28's recorded values (Ceiling Lamps 15, Table Lamps 31, Tableware 29, Mirrors 2, Vases & Plant Pots 13 -- all matched). This confirms www.hay.com serves one global catalogue regardless of visitor country/domain (hay.dk, hay.com root, or Hay.countrySelected cookie value all resolve to the identical product set), exactly the unusual architecture c28 found for us.hay.com/HAY US. Per this project's established duplicate-company convention (S.N. 82 OKA, 85 Overstock, 88 Cost Plus World Market, 137 John Lewis & Partners, 142 XXXLutz Germany, etc.), rows are left EMPTY rather than re-populated -- the real 12-row dataset (Ceiling/Floor/Portable/Table/Wall Lamps, Shades, Candles & Candleholders, Home Decor, Mirrors, Vases & Plant Pots, Drinkware, Tableware) already lives at S.N. 28 / c28.json and should not be double-counted under a second S.N. Orchestrator note: this file originally contained a full re-populated copy of c28's rows (an earlier deviation from the standing convention, corrected before merge on 2026-08-11) -- see c28.json for the authoritative data and its own evidence/flags.
